description: Validate and preview one action on the signed-in person's account: a new purchase, a correction or removal of one purchase, wanting coins, no longer wanting a coin, a wanted coin that was bought, a message to MONETEKA support, or a change of a public link. Nothing changes and nothing is sent here. The result holds the preview for the user, an intent_id and commit_tool — the tool that applies this action once the user approves it.

coin_id.description: coin_id of the wanted coin that was bought.
coin_id.title: Coin Id

expected_revision.description: revision of that wish exactly as get_my_wishlist returned it.
expected_revision.title: Expected Revision

purchase_date.description: Purchase date, YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future. Omit it when the user did not say it.
purchase_date.title: Purchase Date

purchase_price.description: Price paid for ONE coin, in UAH. Omit it when the user did not say it — never guess.
purchase_price.title: Purchase Price

purchase_date.description: Purchase date, YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future. Omit it when the user did not say it.
purchase_date.title: Purchase Date

purchase_price.description: Price paid for ONE coin, in UAH. Omit it when the user did not say it — never guess.
purchase_price.title: Purchase Price

quantity.description: How many coins were bought in this purchase. More than 100 at once is entered in the MONETEKA app.
quantity.title: Quantity

coin_ids.description: Different coin_id values from search_coins. Coins already owned or already wanted are skipped and reported.
coin_ids.title: Coin Ids

note.description: The user's own note for the coin; only when exactly one coin is added.
note.title: Note

expected_revision.description: revision exactly as get_sharing_settings returned it for this kind.
expected_revision.title: Expected Revision

kind.description: collection = the public page of the collection; wishlist = the public page of the wanted coins.
kind.title: Kind

operation.description: create = make the public link; update = change what guests see; disable = pause the page and keep the link; enable = resume it; rotate = replace the link with a new one, the old one stops working; delete = remove the link for good.
operation.title: Operation

settings.description: With create or update: only the settings the user named; the others keep their value.

purchase_date.description: Purchase date, YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future. null clears the stored date.
purchase_date.title: Purchase Date

purchase_price.description: Price paid for ONE coin, in UAH. null clears the stored price.
purchase_price.title: Purchase Price

quantity.description: The new quantity of this purchase.
quantity.title: Quantity

expected_revision.description: revision of that purchase exactly as get_my_collection returned it.
expected_revision.title: Expected Revision

lot_id.description: lot_id of the purchase, from get_my_collection with view=lots.
lot_id.title: Lot Id

expected_revision.description: revision of that wish exactly as get_my_wishlist returned it.
expected_revision.title: Expected Revision

category.description: For a new ticket only: account, coin_data (wrong catalogue data), exchange, fraud, payment, technical, other.
category.title: Category

subject.description: For a new ticket only: a short subject.
subject.title: Subject

text.description: The message exactly as the user approved it, in the user's own language. Do not add anything the user did not say.
text.title: Text

ticket_id.description: An existing ticket id from get_my_support, to reply in it. Omit it to open a new ticket.
ticket_id.title: Ticket Id

display_name.description: The name shown on the public page.
display_name.title: Display Name

show_cost.description: Collection only: show guests what the owner paid in total. true only when the user asked for exactly this.
show_cost.title: Show Cost

show_photo.description: Show guests the owner's Telegram photo. true only when the user asked for exactly this.
show_photo.title: Show Photo

show_price.description: Wishlist only: show guests the market price of each wanted coin.
show_price.title: Show Price

show_value.description: Collection only: show guests the market value of the coins.
show_value.title: Show Value

changes.description: Only the fields that change; the others keep their value.

expected_revision.description: revision of that purchase exactly as get_my_collection returned it.
expected_revision.title: Expected Revision

lot_id.description: lot_id of the purchase, from get_my_collection with view=lots.
lot_id.title: Lot Id

action.description: The one change to preview. collection.add = a new purchase; collection.update = correct one purchase; collection.remove = delete one purchase; wishlist.add = want these coins; wishlist.remove = no longer want a coin; wishlist.acquire = a wanted coin was bought, move it into the collection; support.send = send a message to MONETEKA support; share.change = create, change, pause, replace or delete the public link of the collection or the wishlist.
action.title: Action
